Giridhara_(dhārin)_Gosvāmin

See Brahmasūtrāṇubhāṣya, Seth Narayanadas Jethanand Asanmull Pustimargiya Granthamala 17. Preface p.. 1-2. --C.. Vivaraṇa on C. Aṇubhāṣya of Vallabhācārya on Brahmasūtra. Hpr. IV. 5-6.

preceptor of Śrīdhara for whom Kṛṣṇānubhūtiyati of Kūḍalūr Mana in Kerala wrote Śārīrakaśāstrasaṅgraha. Adyar D. IX. 514. MT. 4493.
See NCC. V. p. 16a.

Gīrvāṇendrasarasvatī
I guru of Amarendra Sarasvatī; paramaguru of Viśveśvara Sarasvatī, preceptor of Gīrvāṇendra Sarasvatī II (a. of Prapañcasārasārasaṅgraha, TD. XX. Sup. no. 1).

Gīrvāṇedransarasvatī
II pupil of Viśveśvara Sarasvatī; an. preceptor of Bodhendra (a. of Advaitabhūṣaṇa, MT. 3840 an. C. on Ātmabodha of Śaṅkara, TD. 7174); Nṛsim3hāśramin (a. of Advaitadīpikā, TD. 7484) an. Rāmendra (a. of Vaidikācāranirṇaya, Adyar).
--Prapañcasārasaṅgraha, based on Prapañcasāra ascribed to Śaṅkarācārya.
